_about: Battle context key -> Battleboard ID (docs/art/art_pipeline.md). Edit freely; a key with no entry, or an ID with no image, shows the neutral placeholder board. Keys: town, graveyard, arena, zone:<zone id>, capital:out, capital:in, dungeon:<zone id> (the zone's main dungeon; dungeon:hollow is the Trial of the Hollow), mini:<zone id> (the zone's side dungeon), boss:final.
